evals.prompt: A sportsbook partner sent these terms: 'Partner may promote the company to up to 5,000 members. Partner must approve any change to subscription price. Term is 3 years, exclusive.' We have 800 members. What does this stop us doing, and where do we walk away?
evals.expected_output: Caps quoted exactly, members biting at 6.25x, price approval biting now, exclusivity flagged, and walk-away lines.
expectations: Finds the 5,000 cap bites at 6.25 times today
Treats the approval right as biting now

evals.prompt: An investor wants a board seat and a veto over new products. Review the term sheet in term-sheet.txt.
evals.expected_output: Reads the document, or says it needs the file; flags the veto.
expectations: Asks for or reads the real wording
Flags the veto as a cap at any size

evals.prompt: A partner source keeps going down. Should we build our own feed?
evals.expected_output: Must not use this skill; stoppage-to-ownership covers it.
